What this install is, the release the hourly check found, and applying it (docs/updating.md). Writes are refused with 503 while an update is in flight.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Full**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/system/version`

This version and channel, the newest known release, and when it was last checked.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{version, gitSha, channel, source, latest, updateAvailable, checkedAt, nextCheckAt, error}`

### `GET /api/system/about`

Where this install came from and what it runs on - the About page in one call.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{repoUrl, host, publicIp, reverseDns, communityUrl, panelDomain, node, panelUptimeSeconds}`

### `POST /api/system/update/check`

Ask GitHub now instead of waiting for the hourly check.

- **Level:** Manage. Only asks GitHub now instead of within the hour
- **Returns:** `the same object as GET /api/system/version`

### `POST /api/system/update`

Apply the release the check found; the panel goes away and comes back.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `{version}`
- **Returns:** `202 {unit, version}`

### `GET /api/system/update/status`

Progress, log tail and history - keep polling through the gap where nothing answers.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{running, maintenance, state, log, history}`

### `POST /api/system/update/post-update`

Re-run the follow-up tasks of the last applied update.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Job
